body: Managing Council 
Rules for access and internal security regime in the autonomous organization 
of education “Nazarbayev University” 
Date of approval:  12.06.2018 Date of entering into force 01.09.2018 
Decision/Minutes No.: No. 12.06.18 
Bylaw classification: 1.12. Safety and labour protection 
Initiator: Alibek Abdullayev, Senior Manager of Campus Security Service 
Related documents 
Vehicle traffic and car park regulations in the 
autonomous organization of education “Nazarbayev 
University” 
 
 
1.General provisions 
1. These Rules for access and inside operations mode in the autonomous 
organization of education “Nazarbayev University” (hereinafter – the Rules) 
specifying access and inside modes procedures within the territory of the autonomous 
organization of education “Nazarbayev University” (hereinafter – the University) are 
mandatory for students, tenants, employees and visitors of the University.  
2. Organization of access and inside modes observation work, as well as 
firefighting and material assets safety shall be assigned to relevant heads of University 
structural divisions and organizations. 
3. These Rules use the following terms, definitions and abbreviations: 
1)  Access mode – a set of rules, actions and procedures specifying access for 
persons and vehicles, their movement within University objects and territory, as well 
as regulating procedure of material assets and property transfer (importation and 
carrying over) among objects. Access mode in University building shall be 24/7; 
2) Inside security regime - a set of organizational and technical events and rules 
aimed at ensuring safety of students, tenants and employees of the University, 
fulfillment of specified internal labor policy; 
3) Permit documents - documents to the right for permanent and temporary 
visiting University premises or import/export material assets provided to persons 
stipulated in Annex 1 hereto;

34. Cultural events may be carried out in case of a relevant permit from the 
Executive Vice President of the University upon coordination with University services 
on regular basis.         
35. Events carried out by third parties shall be regulated by internal regulations 
of the University  
36. Initiator shall inform ACS on events implementation terms via e -mail in 
sufficient time in advance of the expected date of the event. 
37. Notification shall include event aims and tasks, venue, starting and ending 
time, expected number of participants, Initiator`s data, as well as information about 
persons in charge of public order observation during the event (position, addresses, and 
telephone numbers). The notification shall be accompanied with event time schedule. 
38. University organizations, responsible for events implementation, shall 
submit a request  for provision of permits to the building with indication of vehicle 
number and visitors` last names in a timely manner and not later than 1 (one) business 
day before the event.  
39. Authorized persons (Initiators) shall inform event participants on University 
health and safety regulations, as well as inform about the need for medical aid 
organization. 
40. Initiators shall clean the territory of the venue, as well as arrange furniture 
and facilities to their original positions upon event completion at their own expense. 
41. Event initiators shall check the venue together with the ACS not later than 3 
(three) business days before its starting in order to specify its readiness level. Premises 
and adjacent territories must be checked with respect to explosion safety not later than 
1 (one) hour before participants entering with subsequent provision of a relevant 
number of ACS employees. 
42. Events initiators are not entitled to implement these in case of untimely 
request provision, in case if the request was not approved in a due manner and in case 
of refusal to perform an event. 
43. Public events must not be carried out before 7 a.m. and not later than 11 p.m. 
(local time) in order to maintain a public order and in accordance with the legislation 
of RK. 
44. Perso ns who violated public events organization and implementation 
procedure, as well as the requirements of these Rules, shall bear a personal 
responsibility as per the effective legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan. 
45. Material damage infringed to the University and its property, as well as to 
citizens during public event preparation and implementation shall be compensated at 
Initiator`s expense and as per the procedure established by the legislation. 
46. Head of ACS (depending on the event immensity and ACS employee) shall 
provide a relevant briefing aimed at setting tasks to the staff before events 
implementation.

7. Material assets export/importation procedure

7                                                                  Managing Council 
 
47. Material assets export/importation to/from the University territory shall be 
carried out only based on material permits as per Annex 3 hereto and approved by the 
authorized persons irrespective of whether these assets are imported/exported 
temporary or irreversibly. Material permits are one-time permits valid within two days 
after issuance. 
48. Material permits shall be issued against signature of authorized persons 
accountable for assets from the Entity and University organizations. 
49. Material permits shall be issued based on invoice with a certain number 
indicated, and shall be signed by the accountable person and registered at ACS points. 
50. Permit document shall include the name of property exported in words 
(clear), number of places, weight, height of a package. It shall be indicated “As per the 
way bill” in “Cargo name” column of the  permit in case if several items of exported 
assets are listed. 
51. No permits to University building with material assets under oral instruction 
or other ways not stipulated by these Rules are allowed. Material permits shall not grant 
a right for entering University buildings. 
         52. ACS shall maintain material assets export/import log with indication of data 
as follows: 
1) last name and position of an accountable person accepting (delivering) 
material assets; 
2) Time of material assets exportation/importation from/to University building; 
3) Permit number. 
         Material assets export/import log shall be laced, numbered and sealed. 
         53. Employees of the University and other organizations shall register large size 
objects in material assets export/import log in case of their exportation/importation 
from/to the building. 
        54. In case if any incorrectness detected in the document filled, the ACS shall 
suspend material assets exportation/importation, inform the head, shif t leader, and 
responsible officer performing material assets acceptance/delivery, and then act as per 
the instructions received.
